name: Bronte Hughes
bio:
Bronte's motorsport journey began unexpectedly. While studying engineering in Melbourne, she volunteered at a local racing team to gain practical experience. Her sharp analytical skills and knack for problem-solving quickly made her an indispensable asset. She rose through the ranks, initially as a data analyst, then as a race engineer, consistently exceeding expectations. 

As a team principal, Bronte is known for her pragmatic and data-driven approach. She prioritizes clear communication, efficient resource allocation, and fostering a collaborative environment. She believes in empowering her team members and creating a culture of continuous improvement. Bronte is not afraid to make tough decisions, always keeping the long-term goals of the team in sight. Her calm demeanor under pressure is one of her greatest strengths.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with subtle waves
physical.description: Bronte has a focused and intelligent look, with a strong jawline and a warm smile that puts people at ease.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Insists on having a clean and organized workspace, believing it promotes clear thinking.
Has a collection of miniature racing car models on her desk, each representing a significant moment in her career.
